after.name: Flying Dust Water Treatment Plant
after.description: Flying Dust’s December 2025 newsletter reported this water-treatment project as 70% complete. Its Fall 2026 newsletter describes water being produced through reverse osmosis and triple filtration, under a heading “Initiated October 3, 2026”. The calendar separately lists an October 29 ribbon cutting; it does not confirm that ceremony occurred or give a formal completion date. The construction status shown is the historical December 2025 assessment, not a fresh confirmation of the current phase.
